quotations.old_english: Æfter þǽm him becóm on þæt Deniscæ gewinn mid eallum Germánium
quotations.latin: cum insurrexissent gentes innumerabiles, hoc est, Marcomanni atque omnis pene Germania

source_text: Denisc. Add:--Æfter þǽm him becóm on þæt Deniscæ gewinn mid eallum Germánium cum insurrexissent gentes innumerabiles, hoc est, Marcomanni atque omnis pene Germania, Ors. 6, 13; S. 268, 10.
